sub_units.name: React Router
sub_units.content: React Router is a powerful routing library for React that allows you to build single-page applications with navigation. It enables you to define multiple routes and render different components based on the URL, providing a seamless user experience.

sub_units.name: Nested Routes
sub_units.content: Nested routes allow you to define routes within other routes, matching the nested structure of your UI. This is useful for layouts where a portion of the page stays constant while another portion changes based on the sub-route.

sub_units.name: Context API
sub_units.content: The Context API provides a way to pass data through the component tree without having to pass props down manually at every level. It is designed to share data that can be considered 'global' for a tree of React components.

sub_units.name: Prop Drilling
sub_units.content: Prop drilling is a situation where data is passed from a parent component through several intermediate components just to reach a deeply nested child component. While simple, it can make code harder to maintain as the app grows.

sub_units.name: Redux Toolkit
sub_units.content: Redux Toolkit is the official, opinionated, batteries-included toolset for efficient Redux development. It simplifies common Redux tasks like store setup, creating reducers, and writing immutable update logic.

sub_units.name: Global State
sub_units.content: Global state refers to data that is shared across the entire application. Managing global state effectively is crucial for complex applications where multiple components need to stay in sync with the same data source.

sub_units.name: Local Storage
sub_units.content: Web Storage API's localStorage allows you to save key-value pairs in a web browser with no expiration date. In React, it's often used to persist user preferences or authentication tokens across browser sessions.
